title: The normalized projective-line base and trace families
statement: theorem exists_spP1BaseTraceConditions (ℓ : ℕ) (hℓ : ℓ.Prime) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) [Finite (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod (ℓ ^ n)))] : ∃ c : SpP1ChernFamily (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod (ℓ ^ n))) (ℓ ^ n) (CharP.cast_eq_zero (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod (ℓ ^ n))) (ℓ ^ n)), ∃ b : SpP1TwistedFamily (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod (ℓ ^ n))) (ℓ ^ n) (CharP.cast_eq_zero (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod (ℓ ^ n))) (ℓ ^ n)), ∃ d : SpP1DecompositionFamily (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod (ℓ ^ n))) (ℓ ^ n) (CharP.cast_eq_zero (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod (ℓ ^ n))) (ℓ ^ n)), SpP1BaseTraceConditions (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod (ℓ ^ n))) (ℓ ^ n) (pow_pos hℓ.pos n) (CharP.cast_eq_zero (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod (ℓ ^ n))) (ℓ ^ n)) c b d

proof.text: Construct the canonical normalized Chern, twisted and untwisted families.
Apply canonical arbitrary base change and rational-point normalization.
The Chern trace is inr followed by b.hom, b.inv and the second projection, hence identity. Combine the four clauses of SpP1BaseTraceConditions.
